description: A link the customer opens to order a plan (monthly or yearly), register a domain or transfer one. The customer completes the order and pays on clients.hostamir.com.

billing.description: Default monthly. Yearly is 12 months for the price of 10.

plan.description: Plan name: Starter, Business, Pro, KVM 1, KVM 2, KVM 4 or KVM 8

register_domain.description: A domain to search and register, e.g. yourshop.com

transfer_domain.description: True for a link to transfer an existing domain to Hostamir.

name: order_link
title: Make an order link
